From Judgement · Price: the golem takes the shape of what the target wishes for, and you don't choose it.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 2 actions: shape a clay minion from earth or mud (Small, 1 action to command, lasts 1 minute).
  • 5: Surge: build a golem of what a creature wants; it attacks that creature, which is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to it (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard}).
  • 9: Two golems.
  • 13: Golems are Medium and use your stand's Strike.
  • 17: A creature facing its golem is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{fascinated} for 1 round (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
